items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I play his tune all the time. I just played it the other night. Dat Dere.

ctx.x: Then continuing – so, no recollection about Bobby? Because Bobby’s so funky. He was straight out of the church.
I play his tune all the time. I just played it the other night. Dat Dere. We played that, recorded it. We played it the other night.
So that’s what I was just wondering, if . . .
